plan.title: Internal Publishing Readiness and Platform Implementation

narratives.Description: Prepare and, only after separate authorization, implement a governed projection from repository Markdown to the selected private internal knowledge platform. Candidate destinations are an internal wiki, Confluence, or SharePoint.
narratives.Acceptance: A human selects the platform and authorizes publication. Repository Markdown remains the authored source of truth; ownership, permissions, link and navigation mapping, generated-content labeling, synchronization, rollback, version display, and drift handling are defined; platform-specific transformations do not force a wholesale rewrite; and no content becomes public.
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance command; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

items.title: Select the private publication platform and projection contract

narrative.Acceptance: The approved decision records the platform, audience, access controls, source ownership, projection boundaries, synchronization direction, and maintenance owner before any publishing action.

items.title: Implement and verify the authorized internal projection

narrative.Acceptance: The selected private destination preserves navigation, code blocks, callouts, source/version attribution, and learner usability, and its pages can be regenerated or reconciled from repository Markdown.
